label: Dropdown

accessibility.rule: Radix menu keyboard navigation skips disabled items, supports typeahead, and restores trigger focus on Escape. Tab is blocked while the menu is open.
Connect DropdownGroup aria-labelledby to the DropdownLabel id to name each group.
startIcon and endIcon are decorative and hidden from assistive technology; item children provide the accessible label.
Content scrolls vertically within the available viewport; keyboard navigation scrolls focused items into view.

notes: Events are framework-specific and omitted from this contract.
This props list covers Dropdown root; companion-slot props are documented separately because the contract parser only validates root props.
DropdownItem supports startIcon, endIcon, and asChild with a single ref-forwarding element, including links.
DropdownContent supports position (default bottom-start), offset (0), size override, and transition (enter 200ms/out 100ms). Content has spacing-03 block padding (4px).
The token package currently has no elevation, layer, motion, or 240px menu-width tokens. Existing shadow/layer/motion values remain; menu width is derived from spacing-09 (5 × 48px).
